restaurantName: Khok Kloi Tom Yam Noodles with Eggs
address: 6/10 Phet Kasem Road, Khok Kloi, Takua Thung, Phang-Nga, 82140, Thailand
bio: Their fresh tom yum noodles are accompanied by piquant spicy and sour flavours; dry or in an intense broth. They’re known for impressively sized portions at reasonable prices. The soft minced pork and healthy liver have a beautiful scent of fresh lime juice and chilli in a sweet broth....
